evidence_refs: Run39355326426 deployed b7f19b9d1fbb0cb13dcef2efbee1f6138fed77cb. scripts/verify_web_api_deploy.sh check_api_runtime_sha compared the serving release against /api/gates/main-head on every retry. check_web_runtime_sha additionally required an unchanged web image's own SHA to equal that newer main. A queued successor therefore became a false failure of the release ahead of it, with two180second parity loops per pass.

Only the duplicate moving-main API/web parity functions, invocations, obsolete environment knobs and associated281line timer fixture are removed. Existing public API health, web root, CORS and actual request-error handling remain. There is zero added shell implementation; the replacement guidance is Form/BML delivery care.

Current active rollout is owned by its preceding task and has not been reset or raced. The source fix is landed through its own commit, and only this task's obsolete queued native API run may be replaced by the corrected merged successor. Native API implementation and its local retirement branch remain preserved.
